comment.body_excerpt: Windows trigger + workaround for this on 2026.9.9 (Gateway as a non-elevated Scheduled Task) Symptom: after upgrading 2026.7.1-2 → 2026.9. ... llback returns, and plugin dependency capture runs nested inside activateRuntimeSecrets. Auth, ACLs, SQLite and leases were not involved.

reasons: Documents upgrade symptoms, a debugging stack, and a Windows workaround with its security trade-off.
